items.title: Coca-Cola pivots from divisive AI-generated ads for holiday campaign
items.excerpt: After backlash to its generative-AI holiday spots, Coca-Cola's 'Enjoy Joy' campaign returns to live-action footage of family and friends.
items.rationale: The brand that made AI holiday ads famous is walking them back; a clear signal for anyone deciding how much generative AI to put in ad creative.

items.title: AI '가짜 의사' 광고 차단…소비자원, 네이버·카카오·틱톡과 맞손
items.excerpt: 한국소비자원이 네이버·카카오·틱톡과 협력해 AI로 만든 가짜 의사·유명인 부당광고를 모니터링·차단하고 반복 게재 시 플랫폼별 제한 조치를 한다.
items.rationale: A new regulator-platform enforcement pact on AI-generated fake-doctor/celebrity ads with concrete restrictions for repeat offenders; it directly affects what advertisers can run on Korea's major platforms.

items.title: InMobi lets seven AI agents run small firms' Google, Meta and ChatGPT ads
items.excerpt: InMobi Accelerate uses seven AI agents to launch and manage small advertisers' campaigns across Google, Meta and ChatGPT, reporting a 'True ROAS' figure.
items.rationale: New product launch: a multi-agent buying stack that spans Google, Meta and ChatGPT ads for SMBs, one of the first to treat ChatGPT as a managed channel.

items.title: HubSpot won't charge extra when Claude or ChatGPT works its CRM
items.excerpt: HubSpot says everyday CRM use from Claude or ChatGPT is covered by seats and outside agents draw on API plan limits, with credits reserved for heavy governed-agent work.
items.rationale: Concrete pricing policy for outside AI agents working a sales CRM; tells sales and marketing teams what agentic CRM use will actually cost.

items.title: Target's AI shopping assistant is driving sales
items.excerpt: Target's beta AI assistant, Ask Target, is showing early sales success, CEO Michael Fiddelke said on the Q3 call.
items.rationale: A major retailer reporting on its earnings call that its in-house AI shopping assistant is lifting sales, which is evidence the conversational selling surface converts.
